# AIRS Chatbot Lab

> A single-file Flask demo wrapping a local Ollama LLM with Palo Alto Networks
> Prisma AIRS (AI Runtime Security) pre-call and post-call scanning. Built for
> hands-on demos of AI threat detection: prompt injection, data exfiltration,
> malicious code, and toxic content.

## Files

- [README-AH.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AustinH29/airs-chatbot-lab/main/README-AH.txt): Full setup guide, architecture overview, and lab exercises
- [app.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AustinH29/airs-chatbot-lab/main/app.py): Entire application — Flask routes, AIRS scanning logic, LiteLLM integration, and inline HTML/CSS/JS UI
- [.env.example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AustinH29/airs-chatbot-lab/main/.env.example): Configuration template (LLM model, API base, AIRS keys)
- [requirements.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AustinH29/airs-chatbot-lab/main/requirements.txt): Python dependencies
- [llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AustinH29/airs-chatbot-lab/main/llms.txt): This file

## API

- `GET /` — Serves the chat UI
- `POST /chat` — Main chat endpoint; body: `{ message, history, preScan, postScan, model }`; returns full scan + LLM response as JSON
- `GET /api/models` — Lists available Ollama models from localhost:11434
- `GET /health` — Health check; returns server status and configured model name

### /chat response shape

```json
{
  "request":   { "message": "...", "preScan": true, "postScan": true, "model": "ollama/qwen2.5:7b" },
  "pre_scan":  { "action": "allow|block", "category": "...", "scan_id": "...", "latency_ms": 0 },
  "post_scan": { "action": "allow|block", "category": "...", "scan_id": "...", "latency_ms": 0 },
  "response":  "...",
  "blocked":   false,
  "blocked_by": null,
  "explanation": "..."
}
```

`blocked_by` is `"pre-call"`, `"post-call"`, or `null`. When blocked, `response`
contains the block notice text. `explanation` is an AI-generated threat
briefing (present only when AIRS blocks something).

## Architecture

```
User prompt → [AIRS pre-scan] → LiteLLM → Ollama (local) → [AIRS post-scan] → response
```

- LiteLLM runs in-process inside app.py; change `LLM_MODEL` in `.env` to switch
  providers (Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI) with no code changes
- AIRS scanning is optional; without API keys the app runs normally with scans
  marked SKIPPED
- TARS persona — bone-dry deadpan assistant from Interstellar, 75% humor, 90% honesty

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate        # Windows; use source .venv/bin/activate on Mac/Linux
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env          # fill in LLM_MODEL, PANW_PRISMA_AIRS_API_KEY, etc.
python app.py                 # → http://localhost:5000
```

Requires Python 3.10+ and Ollama running locally (`ollama pull qwen2.5:7b`).
AIRS keys are optional for local LLM testing.
